project_name: DC BLOX Atlanta East / ATL2-A East Hyperscale Data Center Campus
aliases: Rockdale County Hyperscale Data Center Campus
status_detail: County staff report identifies a data center complex on 68.41 acres at 1726 and 1830 NW Farmer Road; industry reporting says DC BLOX acquired 72 acres in Conyers for a 750,000-square-foot campus with 216 MW committed by Georgia Power. Local news in 2026 described the Farmer Road DC BLOX data center as the only data center approved for construction at that time.
notes: Official county variance staff report provides parcel, applicant, owner, zoning history and data-center use; capacity comes from DC BLOX/industry reporting.

project_name: Project Rockforge / MMM Acquisitions data center campus
aliases: MMM Acquisitions LLC Farmer Road and Irwin Bridge Road data center campus

status_detail: Rockdale Planning Commission July 9, 2026 agenda lists rezoning and future land-use requests by MMM Acquisitions LLC to permit a data center campus on 262.99 acres at NW Farmer Road and 2000 Irwin Bridge Road NW, plus 19.16 acres at 1921 and 1901 Rockbridge Road NW. Project site says Project Rockforge is a next-generation digital infrastructure hub at 2000 Irwin Bridge Road.
notes: County agenda is the primary evidence. Status kept planned because the agenda reflects zoning/FLUM requests rather than final approval.
